_comment: Hand-curated betting rules (like stadiums.json — never overwritten by refresh). Schema and the closed field/op namespace are enforced by src/nfl_analytics/rules.py; edits are validated at load and a bad rule fails loudly by id. See .claude/rules/data-curation.md.

rules.label: Division dog getting 7+: take the points
rules.notes: Familiarity compresses margins in division games; big favorites often win but don't cover.

rules.label: Rest edge 3+ days: back the rested side
rules.notes: Mini-bye / post-bye edges vs a team on a normal or short week. Side resolves from the sign of rest_edge_days (home minus away, rest_days_sched).

rules.label: Road favorite on a short week: fade (home spread)
rules.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-23: the premise is backwards. Fading the road favorite on <=5 days rest went 50-64-4 (43.9%) 1999-2025, -15.7% ROI. Backing the road favorite instead returns +7.2%, but on 118 bets that is z=+0.80 against the 52.4% breakeven - inside noise, so it was not flipped. Kept as a record so the idea is not re-seeded.

rules.label: Spread steamed 1.5+ toward home: follow (home)
rules.notes: Live-only (line_snapshots start 2026-08-03). spread_move = current - open; positive = market moving toward the home team (spread_line positive = home favored).

rules.label: Spread steamed 1.5+ toward away: follow (away)
rules.notes: Mirror of spread-steam-home. Live-only until line snapshot history accrues.

rules.label: Total dropped 2+ points: ride the under
rules.notes: Live-only. Sharp under money and late weather news both show up as falling totals.

rules.label: Outdoor wind 15+: take the under
rules.notes: Wind kills deep passing and kicking; totals historically don't drop far enough.

rules.label: Flag-happy over referee on a modest total: over
rules.notes: Ref stats are as-of PRIOR seasons only (no lookahead); 30-game minimum keeps the rate meaningful.

rules.label: Team traveling 2+ zones east for an early kick: home spread
rules.notes: A 1pm ET kick is 10am body-clock for a Pacific team. tz_shift_hours positive = traveling east (v_team_games convention).

rules.label: Kalshi vs devigged Vegas gap survives the fee: cheap side
rules.notes: Market-vs-market only (model paused). Actionable = |gap| > kalshi fee + half the bid/ask width (same math as the betting board).

rules.label: Kalshi vs Vegas probability gap 4%+: cheap side
rules.notes: Looser screen than kalshi-dislocation — a watchlist, not an auto-bet.
